$sources: E.030 2018 15, Table 5: the use categories A (essential), B (important), C (common), D (temporary) and the use factor U
source: E.030 2018 Table 5: category A essential buildings U = 1.5 (A1 with base isolation 1.0: not set), B important U = 1.3, C common U = 1.0. The categories I-IV are SAEngine's slots: I and II take C, III B, IV A. The wind importance stays 1.0.

I.description: Category C: common buildings of low occupancy (U = 1.0; category D temporary buildings: at the designer's discretion)

II.description: Category C: common buildings (dwellings, offices, hotels, restaurants) (U = 1.0)

III.description: Category B: important buildings (cinemas, theatres, stadiums, shopping centres, prisons, museums, libraries) (U = 1.3)

IV.description: Category A: essential buildings (hospitals, schools, fire and police stations, emergency centres, power and water facilities) (U = 1.5)
